selection: The fifteen largest United States data centers by current IT power (MW) in the Epoch AI 'AI Data Centers' tracker as of 2026-09-18. Planned end-state figures are Epoch projections from satellite imagery, permits and disclosures; Epoch states an IT-power estimate falls within a factor of 1.4 of the true value about 80% of the time. Campus footprints, where present, are OpenStreetMap outlines (ODbL) simplified to a few points. The first five sites carry hand-curated grid, cooling, on-site generation and footprint detail from the supplementary sources on each record; sites 6 to 15 carry the tracker's own fields only.

source.name: Epoch AI, 'AI Data Centers'
source.citation: Epoch AI, 'AI Data Centers'. Published online at epoch.ai. Retrieved from https://epoch.ai/data/ai-data-centers [online resource].

assumptions.note: Gas-equivalent demand is illustrative arithmetic only: facility MW x 24 h x heat rate / gas energy content, as if the whole load were served by gas-fired generation around the clock. It is not a statement about how a site is actually supplied.
